instruction.text: People can feel differently about the same thing. Look at the images and select the two most likely perspectives on the same thing.

hint.label: Perspectives
hint.text: A perspective is a way a person might think or feel about something.

b: ++“I am afraid because it goes upside down.”
“I am jealous because it goes high.”
++“I am excited to go really fast.”
“I feel angry about dogs.”
++“I find dogs cute.”
++“I find dogs scary.”
++“I am anxious about being in a hospital.”
++“I am curious about what goes on in a hospital.”
“I feel betrayed by the hospital.”
“I feel disgusted about sitting in a car.”
++“I feel optimistic that we can make it fun.”
++“I feel nervous because I get carsick.”
++“I love riding horses because they are beautiful.”
“I feel rejected while riding horses.”
++“I am scared because they are big animals.”
++“I get bored watching football matches.”
++“I am excited to watch the match.”
“I feel suspicious watching the match.”
“I am frustrated because there are books.”
++“I am happy to pick a new book to read.”
++“I find visiting libraries boring.”

atoms.a: walking into your surprise birthday party
b: ++“I feel surprised and very happy.”
“I feel lonely.”
++“I feel a bit shy and embarrassed.”
